entry.content:
xmldom PI grammar regex ReDoS: quadratic backtracking on unterminated processing instructions

Aliases: CVE-2026-83606

Severity: CVSS_V4: CVSS:4.0/AV:N/AC:L/AT:N/PR:N/UI:N/VC:N/VI:N/VA:H/SC:N/SI:N/SA:N

Affected:

  • @xmldom/xmldom — fixed in 0.9.11

## Summary `@xmldom/xmldom`'s processing-instruction (PI) grammar regex exhibits quadratic-time backtracking (ReDoS) when parsing an **unterminated** processing instruction.
